skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 40% ATK DMG to a single back-row target with 5 combo strikes, with a 100% chance to grant self [Tenacity].[Tenacity]: Absorbs DMG equal to 20% of self max HP.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 40% ATK DMG to a single back-row target with 5 combo strikes, with a 100% chance to grant self [Tenacity].[Tenacity]: Absorbs DMG equal to 30% of self max HP.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases self max HP. When an ally's [Tenacity] disappears, launches a [Follow-up] against the attacker.[Follow-up]: Attacks with 80% of the Basic Attack's DMG and effects.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases self max HP. When an ally's [Tenacity] disappears, launches a [Follow-up] against the attacker.[Follow-up]: Attacks with 80% of the Basic Attack's DMG and effects.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases self max HP. When an ally's [Tenacity] disappears, launches a [Follow-up] against the attacker.[Follow-up]: Attacks with 105% of the Basic Attack's DMG and effects.
